title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Renty, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, hold, and protect your personal and payment information when you use our website and services. Because Renty holds rent payments on behalf of renters and landlords, we also explain in detail how that money is handled, held, and released.

content.text: We collect the following types of information:

items: Name, email address, and phone number when you register, fill our contact form, or make an enquiry
Your rental search details — preferred location, budget, and unit type
The M-Pesa phone number used to pay rent. We do not receive or store your M-Pesa PIN — it is entered directly with Safaricom
Confirmation details after you move in, so we know when to release funds to the landlord
Chatbot conversation history when you interact with our assistant
Browsing behavior, device information, and IP address, partly through cookies
For landlords: identity details and the M-Pesa number funds are paid out to
For all account types: your account role (renter, landlord, or platform administrator), since this determines what data you can see

content.text: Your information is used to:

items: Respond to your enquiries and connect you with landlords or listings
Reserve a unit on your behalf while your payment is being processed, and release it again if payment fails or is not completed
Process rent payments and hold funds on trust until your move-in is confirmed or the holding period ends
Calculate and deduct the Renty commission on each completed transaction
Remit the balance to the landlord once the renter confirms the house, or automatically once the holding period has passed
Investigate and resolve complaints or disputes raised by either party
Detect and prevent fraud, including duplicate bookings and double-charging
Improve our platform, dashboards, and services
Send you updates about new listings and offers (only if you opt in)
Comply with Kenyan tax, anti-money laundering, and financial reporting obligations

content.text: When a renter pays rent through Renty, the money does not go directly to the landlord. Instead it moves through the following process:

items: Step 1 — Reservation. When you choose to rent a unit, it is temporarily reserved for you so no one else can book it while your payment is in progress.
Step 2 — Payment. You receive an M-Pesa prompt on your phone. The full rent amount is paid directly to Renty through our payment processing partner.
Step 3 — Commission. Once payment is confirmed, Renty deducts its commission. This is the only amount Renty keeps.

Step 4 — Holding period. The remaining balance is held on the landlord's behalf for a fixed period after payment (currently 72 hours). This period is set by Renty and cannot be extended or shortened by either party.

Step 5 — Release. You can approve the release to the landlord at any time from your dashboard once you have confirmed the unit is as described. If you take no action, the funds are released automatically to the landlord once the holding period ends.
Step 6 — Payout. Once released, funds are sent directly to the landlord's registered M-Pesa number.

content.text: This protects both sides. The renter has a fixed window to confirm the unit before funds are released, and the landlord is guaranteed payment once that window closes, without depending on the renter to take any action.

If your payment fails, is cancelled, or is not completed on your phone, the unit reservation is released automatically and no funds are held. If a payment is disputed after release, contact us using the details in Section 12.
Renty keeps a record of every cancelled or disputed transaction. Specifically:

items: If a booking is cancelled before funds are released to the landlord, the reason for cancellation is recorded and visible to both the renter, the landlord, and Renty's administrators
Renters can raise a complaint about a unit or a landlord directly through their dashboard
Landlords are notified of complaints and can respond to renters directly, including through WhatsApp, using contact details Renty facilitates for that purpose only
Complaint records, including their resolution status, are retained so repeated issues with the same unit or account can be identified

sections.heading: 5. Account Roles & Who Can See Your Data

content.text: Renty has three types of accounts, and access to your data is limited according to which type applies to you:

items: Renters can see their own bookings, payments, and the contact details of landlords they have transacted with. They cannot see other renters' data.
Landlords can see their own units, the renters who have booked them, and payments due to or received by them. They cannot see other landlords' listings or renters they have not transacted with.

Renty's administrators can see platform-wide data — all units, all renters, all landlords, and all transactions — solely to operate the platform, resolve disputes, and meet legal and financial reporting obligations.

content.text: No account type can access another user's payment credentials, M-Pesa PIN, or account password at any time.
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us:

items: Keep you securely logged in to your account between visits
Remember your preferences and saved searches
Analyze how you use our website so we can improve it
Improve site performance and loading speed

content.text: Our login cookie is set as HTTP-only, meaning it cannot be read or accessed by scripts running in your browser. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though disabling essential cookies will prevent you from staying logged in.
We share the minimum data necessary with the following third-party services in order to operate:

items: Safaricom Daraja (M-Pesa) — to send payment prompts, confirm rent payments, and pay out funds to landlords. Safaricom processes your M-Pesa PIN directly; Renty never receives or stores it
Cloudinary — for storing and serving unit images
WhatsApp — used only to let landlords respond to a specific complaint you have raised; it is not used for general marketing
MongoDB Atlas — for secure storage of account, listing, and transaction data
Google Maps — for displaying unit locations, where enabled

content.text: These services have their own privacy policies and process data under their own terms in addition to this policy.
We take data and payment security seriously. Your information is:

items: Stored securely in MongoDB with role-based access controls, as described in Section 5
Protected during transmission using HTTPS
Protected by passwords that are hashed and never stored in plain text
Held in escrow, separate from Renty's own operating funds, during the holding period described in Section 3
Only accessible to authorized personnel bound by confidentiality obligations
Never sold to third parties

content.text: We do not store card numbers, card PINs, or M-Pesa PINs on our servers. All PIN entry happens directly between you and Safaricom.

Some of our service providers, including our cloud database and image storage providers, may store or process data on servers located outside Kenya. Where this happens, we require these providers to maintain security standards consistent with this policy.

If we become aware of a data breach that is likely to affect your personal or payment information, we will notify affected users and, where required, the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner, without undue delay.
Under the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019, you have the right to:

items: Access your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data, unless we are required to keep it for tax or legal reasons
Object to processing of your data
Withdraw consent at any time
Lodge a complaint with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

content.text: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at simonmbithi143@gmail.com.

We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy. Transaction and payment records are kept for the period required under Kenyan tax and financial regulations, even after you stop using Renty. Complaint and dispute records are retained for as long as needed to resolve the matter and to maintain a record for future reference.

Our platform is not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal information, contact us immediately and we will delete it.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the date at the top of this page. If the changes are significant, we will notify you by email or through a notice on the site.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or about how your payment is held, contact us at:
